findings.summary: The alert tile's drush command enables a submodule that does not exist.
findings.detail: drush pm:enable uswds_paragraph_components_alert (singular) names no module at 3.1.x; the actual submodule is uswds_paragraph_components_alerts. An agent following the tile installs nothing. Caught by comparing tile drushCommands against the module's recursive repo tree.

findings.summary: The setup tile's enable list used two singular submodule names that do not exist.
findings.detail: The onboarding tile's drush pm:enable line named uswds_paragraph_components_accordion and …_alert (singular); the actual submodules are …_accordions and …_alerts. Two of nine commands in the canonical full-stack install could not run. The sibling accordion tile was corrected 2026-10-30 (see its provenance) — the manual correction pass fixed one tile and missed the rest; this finding is the argument for automating the check (Tier 0/1 of workspace/docs/drupal-claim-test-plan.md).

findings.summary: The card tile named two paragraph bundles that do not exist ('uswds_card', 'uswds_card_group').
findings.detail: A Tier-3 live install (ddev, Drupal 11.4.12, uswds_paragraph_components 3.1.x enabled) showed the real card family: parents uswds_card_group_regular (children uswds_card_regular) and uswds_card_group_flag (children uswds_cards_flag). The tile's paragraphType and structure block pointed at invented bundle names, so an agent following it could not create the parent paragraph. Field-level claims (dotted bundle.field keys) were all correct — the defect is confined to bundle names.

updates.drupal.org release-history XML for viewsreference: 45 releases, supported branch 8.x-2., latest tagged release 2.0.0-beta14 (no stable 2.x tag exists)
findings.summary: The setup tile's composer command fails on a default Drupal 11 project without a stability override.
findings.detail: uswds_paragraph_components 3.1.x requires drupal/viewsreference ^2.0, but no stable 2.x viewsreference tag exists (2.0.0-beta14 is the latest tag, requiring ^10 || ^11 || ^12). A default project (minimum-stability: stable) cannot resolve the require, so the tile's canonical composer command fails as written. The tile's limitations now document the working configuration (minimum-stability: dev + prefer-stable: true, or an explicit ^2.0-beta14 constraint). Incidental: the release-history XML endpoint verified here answers the Tier-2 open question in workspace/docs/drupal-claim-test-plan.md §5.
